# flatbuffers runtime headers

The header-only C++ runtime of [flatbuffers](https://github.com/google/flatbuffers)
v25.12.19 (`include/flatbuffers/`, only what `flatbuffers.h` includes), under its
Apache-2.0 license.

Code generated by flatc checks that the runtime is exactly flatc's version, so
these are pinned to the flatc that generates `generated/tether/wire_generated.h`.
The ESP component registry has no flatbuffers at this version.

To update, copy the same headers from the new release and regenerate.
